quote: I absolutely felt like a link in my real life, A fascinating story, with a lot of feeling and reflection.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: AdrianView
quote: The game graphically very wow, mechanics very similar to others, however I have no feelings in the story, the errors in the map and vehicles a lot to say, however I feel that it is not a real GTA, apparently the GTA 5 as a story and development left the bar very high, a Trevor a Franklin is missed, etc. the hype submerged and overcame the desire to live it properly and I think it should not be like this.
